description: The shared diff engine of the library: turns two texts into an ordered list of TextDiffHunk values that tile both inputs, so a caller can present the changes, accept or reject each of them and produce the resulting text through Apply. It is a pure, allocation-conscious and UI-free function of its arguments, safe to call from WebAssembly, Server and InteractiveAuto render modes as well as from a backend that never references Blazor. Both historical helpers — the word-level DocumentTextDiffHelper and the line-level TmTextLineDiff — delegate to it, so there is exactly one comparison algorithm in the library. A pathological input never throws and never blocks: above MaxTokens or MaxCells the comparison degrades to a coarser granularity and says so through Fallback.

members.name: Lines
members.description: Compares two texts at line granularity. Lines are split on \n and every character (including a trailing \r and the line breaks) stays inside the hunks, so the hunks tile both inputs; a mixed CRLF/LF pair therefore reports the affected lines as changed instead of silently normalizing them.

members.name: Words
members.description: Compares two texts at word granularity. A token is a word (including its combining marks and digits), a run of digits, or a single punctuation character; whitespace is not a token, so a re-flowed paragraph is not a change, and every hunk keeps the exact characters (including the whitespace between tokens) so that the hunks still tile the inputs.
